name: hud-mode
tagline: A compact HUD that instruments coding agents live
description: hud-mode is a compact heads-up display for watching coding agents work. It instruments an agent in real time, surfacing what the agent is doing in a tight, at-a-glance HUD instead of a wall of logs. For developers running long agent sessions, it turns opaque progress into a glanceable status view. It is written in JavaScript and aimed squarely at the agent-driven development workflow.
highlights: Compact HUD for watching coding agents work in real time
Instruments agent activity into a glanceable status view
Replaces opaque log walls with at-a-glance progress
Built for the agent-driven development workflow
curatorNote: Long agent sessions are hard to follow through raw logs. A compact HUD that instruments what an agent is doing live is exactly the visibility tool agent-driven development has been missing.
